summary: Frontend-only retest of iteration_3 fixes on the live preview host. FIX 1 (header/announcement overlap) VERIFIED on desktop 1920: announcement bar occupies 0-40px, .header-main top=40px, body gets 'has-announcement' class, .main-content padding-top=112px. document.elementFromPoint on every visible header control (logo, Home, About, Programs, Resources, Careers, Franchise, Contact, Free Counselling) resolves to the control itself both before and after scrolling 1500px; Playwright clicks on Contact, Franchise and the About>About Us dropdown item all navigated successfully after scroll. FIX 2 (recruiter logos) VERIFIED: 8 recruiters seeded, 16 looped cards, all 16 from cdn.simpleicons.org loaded (naturalWidth=150), zero broken-image icons, onError fallback spans present but hidden as expected. Admin Partners tab shows 8 cards with all logos loading, no broken images. REGRESSIONS PASS: announcement bar renders and dismiss works on desktop and mobile (body class removed, header returns to top:0), Placed Students section = 4 cards, Recent Events = 4 cards, admin Placed Students modal blocks submit with toast 'Please add a student photo (upload or paste an image URL).' and count stays 4. One NEW medium issue found on mobile 390px: the announcement bar wraps to 3 lines (68px tall) but the header offset is hard-coded to 2.5rem/40px, producing a 28px overlap between the bar and the fixed header (visual only - nav links, hamburger, announcement link and dismiss all remain hit-testable and clickable).

ui_bugs.issue: Announcement bar text wraps to 3 lines => bar height 68px, but 'body.has-announcement .header-main {top: 2.5rem}' (40px) is a fixed offset, so the bar's bottom 28px is overlapped by the fixed header (measured bar.bottom - header.top = 28px). Cosmetic only: hit tests on announcement-text/link/dismiss and all header controls still resolve correctly and clicks work. Suggest measuring the bar height at runtime (ResizeObserver -> CSS var) or shortening the announcement text / using a single-line ellipsis on small screens.

issues: Student Name, Company Name, Position and Order inputs have no visible <label> (only placeholders); after typing, the numeric 'Order' field shows a bare '0' with no context

Left/right 96px white gradient masks cover most of the 390px viewport, so at any time only ~1 logo is fully visible and edge logos look half-faded; consider narrowing the fade to w-10 on small screens

action_items: Optional (MEDIUM): make the has-announcement header offset dynamic so the 3-line mobile announcement bar (68px) does not sit under the header at 390px width
Optional (LOW): add labels to Add Placed Student modal inputs; reduce marquee gradient width on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: globals.css hard-codes the announcement offset (top-10 / pt-[112px]); this is correct only while the bar is exactly 40px tall. Any longer announcement text or smaller viewport re-introduces the overlap. Prefer a CSS variable set from AnnouncementBar via ResizeObserver.
app/eti-manage-x9k2m/page.js is ~3100 lines - should be split into per-tab modules (exceeds the 700-line guideline).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested fixes verified; 1 new medium cosmetic issue

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration_3 defects are fixed and confirmed via elementFromPoint hit tests + real clicks after 1500px scroll (desktop) and via naturalWidth checks on recruiter logos (all 16 load from cdn.simpleicons.org, network reachable from the automation env). Remaining known item: 28px announcement-bar/header overlap at 390px width caused by the fixed 2.5rem offset - cosmetic, not click-blocking. Admin login is rate-limited 5/min; space out attempts.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_3 overlap was caused by AnnouncementBar imperatively mutating .header-main styles; moving state to a body class ('has-announcement') plus CSS rules for .header-main/.main-content/.mobile-menu resolved it. Recruiter logos were broken because clearbit logo API is dead; reseeding with cdn.simpleicons.org plus an onError name fallback resolved it. The residual mobile overlap is because the CSS offset (40px) is a constant while the bar's actual height grows to 68px when the text wraps on narrow viewports.
